info.title: Messaging API
info.description: Contacts, conversations, messages, broadcasts, automations and media for one workspace. The workspace is selected by the API key, so no workspace ID appears in any URL.

domain.description: The domain you sign in to, without https://

bearerAuth.description: A workspace API key: `Authorization: Bearer osk_...`

apiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same workspace API key in the `x-api-key` header.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The workspace is selected by the API key, so no workspace id appears in any /api/v1 URL.

tags.name: Automations
tags.description: Read + activate/pause only. Authoring a node graph stays in the builder, which owns its own validation.

tags.name: Broadcasts
tags.description: The send pipeline is never invoked directly: marking a broadcast scheduled is what lets the sweep's single Scheduled→Sending claim keep it un-double-sendable.

tags.name: Channels
tags.description: Read-only: connecting a channel is an OAuth flow that must happen in the dashboard.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: custom_fields is a flat {key: value} map. An empty map is returned as {} so client-side property access is always safe.

tags.name: Conversations & Messages
tags.description: There is no Conversation model: a conversation is a Contact with messages, and the rollup fields are denormalised columns on it.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Upload requests are multipart, not JSON — do not set Content-Type: application/json on media.store.

tags.name: Segments
tags.description: Segments are the audience type broadcasts target.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Contacts are tagged by NAME (see contacts.tags.add), so tag names stay unique.

get.description:
Returns the workspace (account) the API key belongs to. Use it as a connectivity / auth check.

**Required permission:** any messaging permission.

Paginated list of flows and quick automations. `live` tells you whether an automation actually answers right now — a flow switched on but never published shows status active while every inbound skips it.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:automations:read`

Returns a single automation.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:automations:read`

post.description:
Switches it on. Refused (422) if the plan's per-channel active-bot cap is reached, if a flow has no published version, or if the published flow uses a step the plan does not include.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:automations:write`

Switches it off. Conversations mid-flow are unaffected until they finish.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:automations:write`

get.description:
Paginated list of campaigns with their aggregate delivery counters.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:read`

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: draft | scheduled | sending | sent | paused | cancelled | failed

post.description:
Creates a campaign. Draft unless `schedule` is true. `timezone_mode: contact` sends the same wall-clock in each recipient's own timezone and requires `scheduled_local_at`. Set `type: retarget` with `source_broadcast_id` + `retarget_engagement` to re-message a prior broadcast's recipients instead of a segment.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:write`

get.description:
Returns a single broadcast with its channel and delivery counters.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:read`

put.description:
Partial update, allowed only while draft or scheduled — an in-flight or finished broadcast is a historical record. Re-enabling `requires_approval` voids any prior sign-off.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:write`

post.description:
Clears the approval gate, records the approver, and schedules the broadcast.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:write`

Schedules the broadcast for immediate send; the dispatch sweep claims it. Refused for anything not draft or scheduled (so an audience cannot be messaged twice) and for a broadcast still held for approval.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:write`

get.description:
The per-contact delivery rows, with status, provider message id and any error.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:read`

Paginated list of connected messaging channels. `name` is the live profile name, not the connect-time snapshot.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:channels:read`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the channel name, handle or account name

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: whatsapp | facebook | instagram | sms | telegram | livechat | tiktok | …

get.description:
Returns a single channel by id.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:channels:read`

Paginated, filterable list of contacts with their tags and pipeline stage.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search name, handle, phone or email

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Stage id, or "none" for contacts with no stage

parameters.name: tags[]
parameters.description: Tag ids — matches a contact carrying ANY of them

parameters.name: has_phone
parameters.description: Only contacts with a phone number

parameters.name: has_email
parameters.description: Only contacts with an email address

post.description:
Creates a contact and fires contact.created. To make it reachable on WhatsApp, supply `channel` (one of the workspace's WhatsApp numbers), `phone` in international form and `opt_in_attested: true`, confirming the person agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from you; no other channel can be bound here. A number another contact already holds is refused. Subject to the workspace's plan contact cap.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

Applies one action to up to 500 contacts: up to 50 inline, more queued (202, `queued: true`). Actions: delete, add_tag, remove_tag, set_stage. `value` is the tag NAME for add_tag/remove_tag and the stage id for set_stage. Per-contact webhooks still fire; contact-event automation triggers are suppressed so a bulk change cannot stampede the flow engine. `delete` also needs the key creator to hold the bulk-delete permission.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

get.description:
Returns a single contact with its tags and stage.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

put.description:
Partial update — omitted fields keep their stored value. Any tags supplied are ADDED, never synced. Fires contact.updated.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

delete.description:
Deletes the contact and cascades its channel identities, messages, notes and tag links.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

post.description:
Attaches tags by name, creating any that do not exist. Fires contact.tagged and the tag_applied automation trigger.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

delete.description:
Detaches tags by name. Names that do not exist are ignored — no tag is created just to detach it.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

post.description:
Records an internal note on the contact. Never sent to the customer.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

put.description:
Sets (or clears, with null) the contact's stage and fires contact.stage_changed with the previous stage.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

get.description:
The unified inbox, newest activity first. A conversation IS a contact, so the id here is the contact id and can be passed straight back as `contact_id` when sending. Archived threads are excluded unless asked for.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:read`

Returns one conversation with its rollup fields and current assignee.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:read`

The thread, oldest first, paginated — so a client appends pages instead of reversing them.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:read`

put.description:
Closing stamps the reopen window and settles any automation a human takeover parked. `parked_action` (resume | skip | keep | end) overrides the workspace resume policy for this close.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:write`

Assigns the conversation to a workspace member, or hands it back with a null user_id. Emits conversation.assigned and notifies the new owner. Non-members are rejected.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:write`

Pausing freezes any running automation on this conversation; resuming unfreezes it. Idempotent — retrying a request cannot flip the state back.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:write`

Blocking stops outbound messages and pauses the bot so no automation re-engages them.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:write`

post.description:
Records an internal note on the conversation. Never sent to the customer.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:write`

Sends on the channel the customer last used (or the identity or channel uuid in `channel`), records it in the thread and fires the same message.* webhooks a dashboard reply does. Counted as a BOT send: it needs the workspace in good standing, never takes the conversation over, and gets the bot's messaging window. Refused with 422 (with a `reason`) when the contact is blocked or opted out, or the window is closed — send an approved template (`type: template`, `template_id`, `parameters`) to re-engage. Media (while inbox media is on) is sent by reference: `media.library` (an id from POST /media) or `media.source_message_id`; a URL is refused. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retried request one send.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:messages:send`

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a retried request a single send.

get.description:
Paginated list of the workspace media library, newest first.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:media:read`

post.description:
multipart/form-data with a `file` field. Runs the same upload pipeline as the dashboard, so the file gets its thumbnail conversions and the workspace storage path. Allowed mime types and the per-type size cap come from the install's file config.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:media:write`

get.description:
Returns a single item with a resolved URL.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:media:read`

delete.description:
Detaches the item from any post version that referenced it, then deletes the files and the record.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:media:write`

get.description:
Paginated list of saved contact filters. Counts are opt-in — evaluating a grouped-conditions segment is a real query, so it is not run once per row unless asked for.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

parameters.name: with_counts
parameters.description: Include the live contact count for every segment

post.description:
Creates a saved filter. Tags are referenced by tag id. `conditions` is an optional grouped rule tree; unknown fields and operators are stripped by the shared sanitiser, so an invalid rule is dropped rather than silently matching everything.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

get.description:
Returns a single segment plus its live contact count.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

put.description:
Partial update — an omitted key keeps its stored value, so changing the name cannot erase the conditions.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

delete.description:
Deletes the saved filter. Contacts are unaffected.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

get.description:
Evaluates the segment live and returns the matching contacts, paginated. A segment stores a query, never a membership list, so results reflect the data at request time.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

Paginated list of contact tags with contact counts.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

post.description:
Creates a tag, or returns the existing one with the same name (200 instead of 201).

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

get.description:
Returns a single tag by id.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

put.description:
Renames or recolours a tag.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

delete.description:
Deletes a tag and detaches it from every contact. The built-in Unsubscribe tag is refused — it is the opt-out marker the broadcast pipeline filters on.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`
